findings.key_quote: Energy generation and storage revenue increased $2.69 billion, or 27%, in the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared to the year ended December 31, 2024
findings.justification: This passage directly states that energy generation and storage revenue increased by 27% for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. Since 27% > 20%, this entails the assertion that the increase was more than 20%.

findings.key_quote: Energy generation and storage segment Revenues $ 12,771 $ 10,086
